name: the Giardino dei Semplici
title: Ancient Trees in Florence's Botanical Garden: 7 Giants
meta_description: The third-oldest botanical garden in the world, founded 1545 for the Medici, and the seven remarkable trees still standing in it.
intro: Cosimo I de' Medici founded this garden in 1545 to grow medicinal plants, which makes it the third oldest botanical garden in the world and older than most of what surrounds it. The name means the garden of the simples, simples being the single-ingredient herbs a physician worked from before pharmacy existed. Seven of the trees we map grow inside its walls, and several are the kind of specimen a botanical garden accumulates precisely because somebody was paid to keep them alive for four hundred years.
